cards.name: Camera Fly-through
cards.what: Move the camera through connected positions while directing its gaze toward the destination.
cards.conveys: Connects separate scenes into a spatial journey.
useWhen: Connect separated information cards through space.
Travel through a tunnel to the next scene.

cards.name: Camera Follow
cards.what: Follow a moving subject by shifting the world in the opposite direction.
cards.conveys: Keeps the current action readable.
useWhen: Keep the caret visible during long input.
Follow the latest section of a moving time series.

cards.name: Camera Orbit
cards.what: Orbit a centered subject to reveal its shape and changing background relationships.
cards.conveys: Conveys three-dimensional form and orientation.
useWhen: Reveal the front and side of a product.
Bring a globe destination to the front.

cards.name: Camera Shake
cards.what: Shake the entire scene with small translations and rotations that decay after impact.
cards.conveys: Conveys impact and handheld instability.
useWhen: Emphasize the instant after a collision.
Add a brief handheld feel.

cards.name: Crane Tilt
cards.what: Move the viewpoint vertically while changing its viewing angle.
cards.conveys: Conveys height and spatial scale.
useWhen: Descend from a tall structure to eye level.
Reveal a subject while showing the scale of its surroundings.

cards.name: Dolly Zoom
cards.what: Keep the subject size fixed while camera distance and field of view change together.
cards.conveys: Conveys unease or a sudden realization.
useWhen: Show a spatial shift at a moment of realization.
Change background compression behind a subject.

sources.title: motion dictionary 2-transitions-camera.md#38. 돌리 줌 · Dolly Zoom / Vertigo Effect

cards.name: Fly-to
cards.what: Zoom out from one place, travel across the wider view, then zoom into the destination.
cards.conveys: Preserves the relationship between distant locations.
useWhen: Connect two distant places.
Visit a list of regions in sequence.

cards.name: Frame Scrub
cards.what: Map progress to an image or video frame, including reverse scrubbing.
cards.conveys: Makes detailed stages and product views explorable.
useWhen: Let viewers explore a product rotation.
Inspect intermediate steps of an assembly breakdown.

cards.name: Giant Mask Reveal
cards.what: A frame-filling 939 acts as a window onto an editorial world, and the camera dives into a stroke until the whole world is revealed.
cards.conveys: A bigger story lives inside the number or word. One move carries the viewer from cover to content.
useWhen: Move from a headline number or title into a detailed plate.
Open a video by diving into a brand number or logo.

cards.name: Infinite Canvas Pan
cards.what: A continuous 5,400px camera pan across six editorial plates settles on a scarlet focus.
cards.conveys: Continuity and breadth across a single connected canvas.
useWhen: Connect several steps or statistics across one editorial canvas.
Guide attention across a wide map or composition.

cards.name: Infinite Zoom
cards.what: Dive into a scarlet dot three times as nested plates expand through a continuous 2,744× zoom.
cards.conveys: Recursive depth as each small detail contains another full composition.
useWhen: Travel continuously from overview into detail and conclusion.
Explain recursion through nested visual structure.

cards.name: Lens Distortion Zoom
cards.what: Zoom toward the center while radial lens distortion rises and returns to zero.
cards.conveys: Conveys a strong approach and wide-angle spatial expansion.
useWhen: Draw attention with a brief approach.
Add wide-angle expansion to a transition.

cards.name: Perspective Tilt Reveal
cards.what: An editorial page tilts back by 55 degrees to reveal its grid before returning to one frontal figure.
cards.conveys: The relationship between a detail and the full editorial structure.
useWhen: Reveal the full structure around a single figure.
Return from an information atlas to its key figure.

cards.name: Screen Shake
cards.what: The screen or a word trembles side to side briefly and quickly settles.
cards.conveys: Makes hits, collisions and tension felt physically. A short, strong single emphasis.
useWhen: Land a heavy word or an impact moment.
Signal a warning or error briefly.

cards.name: Scroll-scrub Cinema Scene
cards.what: In one pinned scene, a single scroll progress value p drives a title mask reveal, an assembling diagram, and a parallaxing background number together.
cards.conveys: The scene advances only as far as the viewer scrolls. Every layer is bound to one value, so they stop together and rewind together.
useWhen: Use when a scroll deck pins one scene and assembles its parts step by step.
Use when showing or pitching a scroll-linked scene as video.
Use when speed differences between title, diagram, and background layers should add depth.

cards.name: Vanishing Point Shift
cards.what: Shift the vanishing point to change the viewpoint without moving the layout substantially.
cards.conveys: Suggests a low-angle view or subtle observation shift.
useWhen: Observe a three-dimensional panel from a low angle.
Shift the viewpoint subtly while preserving the layout.

cards.name: Annotation Callout
cards.what: An animation that draws a leader line from a point on a chart and then reveals an annotation.
cards.conveys: Highlights a significant data point and its meaning.
useWhen: When highlighting a significant data point and its meaning
When adding a selection-rate annotation to a point on a completed chart

cards.name: Bar Grow
cards.what: An animation in which bars grow from a baseline to lengths proportional to their values.
cards.conveys: Shows differences in probability and ranking among candidates.
useWhen: When showing differences in candidate probabilities and ranking
When comparing next-word candidate probabilities by length on a shared scale

cards.name: Count-up
cards.what: An animation in which a number increases from 0 to its target value while decelerating.
cards.conveys: Communicates numerical accumulation and the final magnitude.
useWhen: When showing numerical accumulation and the final magnitude
When counting tokens from 0 to 939 and then revealing the token unit

cards.name: Dot Regroup
cards.what: An animation that moves scattered dots into orderly groups by category.
cards.conveys: Shows which group each sample belongs to and the size of each group.
useWhen: When showing sample membership and group sizes
When splitting 30 samples into groups of 18 and 12 to show the difference in count

cards.name: Line Draw
cards.what: An animation that progressively reveals a path from start to finish.
cards.conveys: Shows how values change over time and the direction of progression.
useWhen: When showing changes in value over time and the direction of progression
When drawing a chronological line chart with a dot marking the current position

cards.name: Unit Grid Fill
cards.what: An animation that fills a specified number of cells in sequence within a grid representing the whole.
cards.conveys: Shows both the proportion and the actual count of a subset.
useWhen: When showing the proportion and actual count of a subset
When filling 18 of 30 cells to show a selection rate of 60%

cards.name: Aggregate Split and Merge
cards.what: An aggregate mark splits into detailed marks, or detailed marks merge into one aggregate.
cards.conveys: Shows the inclusion relationship between totals and their components.
useWhen: Use when you need to explain aggregate split and merge while preserving item identities and chart scales.
Use when the audience needs to follow the intermediate states rather than only compare final snapshots.

cards.name: Audio Spectrum Visualizer
cards.what: Bars or radial lines change length using precomputed audio band samples.
cards.conveys: Shows the spectral composition and energy of sound.
useWhen: Visualize frequency-band energy in audio.
Keep the encoded values, labels, and visual state synchronized.

cards.name: Audio Waveform
cards.what: A line changes over time to display the amplitude of an audio signal.
cards.conveys: Makes the dynamics of speech and music visible.
useWhen: Show speech intensity beneath an interview excerpt.
Display the amplitude of a soundtrack alongside playback.

cards.name: Axis Rescaling
cards.what: Ticks and gridlines move to a new scale as marks update with them.
cards.conveys: Separates changes in data from changes in chart scale.
useWhen: Use when explaining axis rescaling in a presentation or interactive view.
Use when viewers need to track corresponding items between states.

cards.name: Bar Chart Race
cards.what: Bar lengths and vertical ranks interpolate between time steps.
cards.conveys: Shows competition and overtaking over time.
useWhen: Compare changing ranks over time.
Keep the encoded values, labels, and visual state synchronized.

cards.name: Beeswarm Settling
cards.what: Nearby observations spread into a non-overlapping band while keeping their value-axis positions.
cards.conveys: Shows individual observations and local distribution density together.
useWhen: Use when you need to explain beeswarm settling while preserving item identities and chart scales.
Use when the audience needs to follow the intermediate states rather than only compare final snapshots.

cards.name: Boxplot Update
cards.what: The median, quartiles, and whisker endpoints move to updated summary positions.
cards.conveys: Compares changes in a distribution’s center and spread.
useWhen: Use when explaining boxplot update in a presentation or interactive view.
Use when viewers need to track corresponding items between states.

cards.name: Brush-linked Update
cards.what: Moving or resizing a brush window updates a linked detail chart.
cards.conveys: Connects the full time series to the selected interval.
useWhen: Use this effect when you need to communicate: Connects the full time series to the selected interval.
Explain intermediate values and selected ranges in a scroll-driven data story.

cards.name: Animated Bubble Time Series
cards.what: Bubbles change position and area together as the displayed time advances.
cards.conveys: Connects trajectories across multiple indicators with changes in scale.
useWhen: Use when you need to explain animated bubble time series while preserving item identities and chart scales.
Use when the audience needs to follow the intermediate states rather than only compare final snapshots.

cards.name: Bump Chart Reveal
cards.what: Rank trajectories unfold over time, crossing as items exchange positions.
cards.conveys: Emphasizes changes in rank and how long each rank persists.
useWhen: Use when you need to explain bump chart reveal while preserving item identities and chart scales.
Use when the audience needs to follow the intermediate states rather than only compare final snapshots.

cards.name: Cartogram Transition
cards.what: Regions move from geographic positions into a grid or value-sized layout.
cards.conveys: Links geographic size with the magnitude represented by data.
useWhen: Use when explaining cartogram transition in a presentation or interactive view.
Use when viewers need to track corresponding items between states.

cards.name: Connected Change Arrows
cards.what: An arrow extends from a fixed previous position toward the updated position.
cards.conveys: Encodes both the direction and magnitude of change.
useWhen: Use when you need to explain connected change arrows while preserving item identities and chart scales.
Use when the audience needs to follow the intermediate states rather than only compare final snapshots.

cards.name: Chart Filter Fade
cards.what: Marks outside a filter fade away while marks matching the new condition appear.
cards.conveys: Clarifies which observations remain after a condition changes.
useWhen: Use when you need to explain chart filter fade while preserving item identities and chart scales.
Use when the audience needs to follow the intermediate states rather than only compare final snapshots.

cards.name: Chart Path Morph
cards.what: A chart line or area continuously reshapes to match a new dataset.
cards.conveys: Preserves continuity while comparing earlier and later trends.
useWhen: Update a line chart when the selected period changes.
Compare two trend profiles on a fixed axis.

cards.name: Chart Scrub
cards.what: A cursor and linked readout travel across a completed chart.
cards.conveys: Makes a chart readable as a sequence of values.
useWhen: Inspect values along an existing chart.
Keep the encoded values, labels, and visual state synchronized.

cards.name: Choropleth Transition
cards.what: Map regions transition to colors encoded from data values.
cards.conveys: Reveals geographic differences in a metric.
useWhen: Compare regional values and distributions.
Keep the encoded values, labels, and visual state synchronized.

cards.name: Color Encoding Transition
cards.what: Stationary marks change color to reflect updated values or categories.
cards.conveys: Isolates changes in encoding without introducing spatial motion.
useWhen: Use when explaining color encoding transition in a presentation or interactive view.
Use when viewers need to track corresponding items between states.

cards.name: Confidence Band Reveal
cards.what: A translucent interval around an estimate unfolds in time or changes width.
cards.conveys: Shows the estimated trend together with its uncertainty range.
useWhen: Use when you need to explain confidence band reveal while preserving item identities and chart scales.
Use when the audience needs to follow the intermediate states rather than only compare final snapshots.

cards.name: Spatiotemporal Density Animation

cards.conveys: Reveals spatial concentration and movement instead of individual points.
useWhen: Use when explaining spatiotemporal density animation in a presentation or interactive view.
Use when viewers need to track corresponding items between states.

cards.name: Donut Ring Staging
cards.what: Donut slices separate into concentric rings, change position and share, then reunite.
cards.conveys: Separates positional changes from proportional changes for easier tracking.
useWhen: Use when you need to explain donut ring staging while preserving item identities and chart scales.
Use when the audience needs to follow the intermediate states rather than only compare final snapshots.

cards.name: Force-directed Layout Settling
cards.what: Connected nodes relax under link forces, repulsion, and damping until the layout settles.
cards.conveys: Reveals a spatial structure emerging from network relationships.
useWhen: Use when you need to explain force-directed layout settling while preserving item identities and chart scales.
Use when the audience needs to follow the intermediate states rather than only compare final snapshots.

cards.name: Formation Transition
cards.what: Player markers move between formations with trails showing their paths.
cards.conveys: Explains team movement and changes in spatial organization.
useWhen: Use when explaining formation transition in a presentation or interactive view.
Use when viewers need to track corresponding items between states.

cards.name: Fractional Icon Fill
cards.what: A clipping boundary fills icons to the exact fractional value.
cards.conveys: Communicates whole and fractional quantities.
useWhen: Show a fractional rating.
Keep the encoded values, labels, and visual state synchronized.

cards.name: Freeze and Replay
cards.what: A chart holds at a checkpoint, displays an annotation, then replays the interval.
cards.conveys: Makes a brief critical change readable in context.
useWhen: Use when explaining freeze and replay in a presentation or interactive view.
Use when viewers need to track corresponding items between states.

cards.name: Gantt Progress
cards.what: A time cursor crosses task bars while their completed portions grow.
cards.conveys: Makes task durations and overlapping schedules readable.
useWhen: Explain overlapping tasks in a project schedule.
Replay actual completion against planned dates.

cards.name: Histogram Rebinning

cards.conveys: Explains how bin choice affects the apparent shape of a distribution.
useWhen: Use when you need to explain histogram rebinning while preserving item identities and chart scales.
Use when the audience needs to follow the intermediate states rather than only compare final snapshots.

cards.name: Interval Expansion

Show minimum and maximum values while preserving the central marker.

cards.name: Line Chart Race

useWhen: Use when you need to explain line chart race while preserving item identities and chart scales.

cards.name: Linear-to-log Transition

Present corresponding elements in a readable sequence within the same view.

cards.conveys: Shows where movement starts, ends, and proceeds.

cards.name: Delta Triangle Shrink
cards.what: Horizontal and vertical change segments shrink together while their labels remain attached.
cards.conveys: Makes the ratio between small input and output changes readable.
useWhen: Explain causes and results using delta triangle shrink.
Present corresponding elements in a readable sequence within the same view.

cards.name: Dependent Geometry Update
cards.what: A moving point updates its connected line, angle, and length at the same instant.
cards.conveys: Reveals how one changing quantity determines related geometry.
useWhen: Explain how a moving point changes a line length.
Keep angle and distance labels attached during a geometry demonstration.

cards.name: Fourier Winding
cards.what: Signal samples wind around a rotating frame while their mean moves with frequency.
cards.conveys: Reveals why a matching frequency produces a distinct mean displacement.
useWhen: Explain causes and results using fourier winding.
Present corresponding elements in a readable sequence within the same view.

cards.name: Globe-to-map Projection Morph
cards.what: A globe’s surface grid unfolds into a flat projection, changing regional shapes.
cards.conveys: Explains where distortion in a map projection comes from.
useWhen: Explain causes and results using globe-to-map projection morph.
Present corresponding elements in a readable sequence within the same view.

cards.name: Node-link Build
cards.what: Reveal eight service nodes before their connecting edges.
cards.conveys: Shows relationships and processing order.
useWhen: Explain dependencies between services.
Keep the encoded values, labels, and visual state synchronized.

cards.name: Harmonic Component Assembly
cards.what: Sine components accumulate into a composite waveform that approaches a target shape.
cards.conveys: Shows that a complex waveform can be built from simple components.
useWhen: Explain causes and results using harmonic component assembly.
Present corresponding elements in a readable sequence within the same view.

cards.name: Inverse Kinematics Reach
cards.what: Connected joints bend to place a hand or foot at a target position.
cards.conveys: Shows how an end-effector target determines the pose of an entire joint chain.
useWhen: Explain how a robot arm reaches an object.
Demonstrate a character reaching with a hand or planting a foot.

cards.name: Lighting Pass Accumulation
cards.what: Individual lighting passes appear and accumulate into the final composite.
cards.conveys: Shows how multiple light contributions build a rendered image.
useWhen: Explain causes and results using lighting pass accumulation.
Present corresponding elements in a readable sequence within the same view.

cards.name: Matching Token Transform
cards.what: Semantically matched tokens move to their next positions while other tokens fade.
cards.conveys: Separates preserved meaning from added or removed terms.
useWhen: Explain code or equation transformations.
Keep the encoded values, labels, and visual state synchronized.

cards.name: Memory Chunk Allocation
cards.what: A data block splits into chunks as matching memory slots fill in sequence.
cards.conveys: Explains how data size maps to memory allocation.
useWhen: Explain causes and results using memory chunk allocation.
Present corresponding elements in a readable sequence within the same view.

cards.name: Object Tracking Box
cards.what: A bounding box follows the position and size of a subject.
cards.conveys: Shows that a system recognizes and tracks an object.
useWhen: Explain object detection and tracking.
Keep the encoded values, labels, and visual state synchronized.

cards.name: Path Beam
cards.what: A short luminous segment travels along a connector toward an active node.
cards.conveys: Shows signal direction and the currently active stage.
useWhen: Highlight a processing path.
Keep the encoded values, labels, and visual state synchronized.

cards.name: Path Convoy
cards.what: Objects follow the same path with staggered starts or fixed spacing.
cards.conveys: Makes logistics, packet transfer, and processing flow visible.
useWhen: Show packets traveling along a network route.
Trace a procession of units through a logistics path.

cards.name: Pinned Scrollytelling
cards.what: A visual stays pinned while scrolling explanations change its internal state and emphasis.
cards.conveys: Explains a sequence of ideas around one stable visual reference.
useWhen: Explain a code sample through four successive highlights.
Keep a diagram visible while prose describes its stages.
