cards.name: Plane Transformation
cards.what: A grid and its shapes deform under one shared coordinate transformation.
cards.conveys: Shows how a function or matrix acts on the entire plane.
useWhen: Use when explaining plane transformation in a presentation or interactive view.
Use when viewers need to track corresponding items between states.

cards.name: Process Loop
cards.what: An actor or icon visits successive stages in a repeating process.
cards.conveys: Clarifies roles and order within a cycle.
useWhen: Explain causes and results using process loop.
Present corresponding elements in a readable sequence within the same view.

cards.name: Secant-to-tangent Convergence
cards.what: Two points on a curve approach each other as their secant approaches a tangent.
cards.conveys: Shows instantaneous rate of change as a limiting process.
useWhen: Explain causes and results using secant-to-tangent convergence.
Present corresponding elements in a readable sequence within the same view.

cards.name: Seesaw Balance
cards.what: A beam tilts around a shared fulcrum while its pans counter-rotate.
cards.conveys: Expresses balance and tradeoffs.
useWhen: Compare the weight of two choices.
Keep the encoded values, labels, and visual state synchronized.

cards.name: Segmentation Reveal
cards.what: A scan progressively reveals predefined colored region masks.
cards.conveys: Shows a system analyzing separate parts of a subject.
useWhen: Explain region-level image analysis.
Keep the encoded values, labels, and visual state synchronized.

cards.name: Sequence Message Draw
cards.what: Message arrows draw between actors in chronological order, highlighting each receiver.
cards.conveys: Shows who sends each request and response, and when.
useWhen: Explain a client, server, and database exchange.
Trace an approval request through several roles.

cards.name: Source-to-result Mapping
cards.what: The source remains visible as transformed code appears with linked corresponding tokens.
cards.conveys: Explains how a high-level representation becomes an executable form.
useWhen: Explain causes and results using source-to-result mapping.
Present corresponding elements in a readable sequence within the same view.

cards.name: Speech Bubble Reveal
cards.what: A speech bubble opens beside a character, reveals text, then collapses.
cards.conveys: Makes the speaker of a question or answer clear.
useWhen: Explain causes and results using speech bubble reveal.
Present corresponding elements in a readable sequence within the same view.

cards.name: State Transition Walk
cards.what: A signal moves to the next node, which becomes the active state.
cards.conveys: Shows order and valid transition paths.
useWhen: Explain a sequence of state changes.
Keep the encoded values, labels, and visual state synchronized.

cards.name: Step-panel Walkthrough
cards.what: The active step moves through a list as a neighboring code panel updates.
cards.conveys: Shows both the current task and its place in the overall sequence.
useWhen: Explain causes and results using step-panel walkthrough.
Present corresponding elements in a readable sequence within the same view.

cards.name: Step Recap Reconstruction
cards.what: Small illustrations of completed steps gather into a single recap flow.
cards.conveys: Reinforces the overall process and the relationships between its steps.
useWhen: Explain causes and results using step recap reconstruction.
Present corresponding elements in a readable sequence within the same view.

cards.name: Timeline Scrub
cards.what: A playhead moves along a time axis and reveals the event or map state at each date.
cards.conveys: Connects chronological order to changing states.
useWhen: Explain causes and results using timeline scrub.
Present corresponding elements in a readable sequence within the same view.

cards.name: Vector Field Alignment
cards.what: Short bars in a grid turn toward a moving reference point.
cards.conveys: Shows the direction and spatial influence of a vector field.
useWhen: Illustrate the directions around a moving field source.
Compare spatial direction patterns at different source positions.

cards.name: Vector Tip-to-tail Construction
cards.what: Component vectors extend in sequence, then join tip to tail to form a resultant.
cards.conveys: Explains vector addition and linear combinations spatially.
useWhen: Explain causes and results using vector tip-to-tail construction.
Present corresponding elements in a readable sequence within the same view.

cards.name: Venn Overlap
cards.what: Circles move together, then reveal the highlighted intersection and its label.
cards.conveys: Distinguishes shared properties from differences between sets.
useWhen: Explain shared features of two or three concepts.
Reveal the intersection of audience segments.

cards.name: Narration-synchronized Motion
aka: Temporal contiguity of explanation and change
cards.what: When the narration names a cause, the matching visual change happens at the same moment.
cards.conveys: Speech and the event on screen fuse into one idea, which is easier to grasp.
useWhen: When a shape must appear as its term is spoken
When two changes should land on their spoken cause and effect

cards.name: Route Highlight
cards.what: Nodes and links along a route light up in order from start to finish while the rest fades.
cards.conveys: Follows a single flow through a complex network.
useWhen: When tracing one path such as a customer journey or money flow
When showing a chosen prerequisite chain in a dependency graph

cards.name: Segmented Explanation
cards.what: A long process is split into short bursts of motion, each followed by a still hold.
cards.conveys: Reduces information at once. Understanding settles during the holds.
useWhen: When explaining a process of 4 or more steps in video
When a scroll deck should stop at each step

cards.name: Tile Possibility Collapse
cards.what: Each grid cell shows overlapping candidate tiles that commit one by one while neighbor options shrink, until the pattern is complete.
cards.conveys: Local constraints determine global structure, and disorder converges into rules.
useWhen: Explaining how an algorithm or generative model builds structure from rules
Visualizing how a procedural pattern is generated

cards.name: Grid Draw
cards.what: Horizontal and vertical lines draw in sequence to build a grid.
cards.conveys: Establishes a coordinate system or modular layout reference.
useWhen: Introduce coordinates before plotting data.
Reveal the module spacing of a design system.

cards.name: Collision Displacement
cards.what: An incoming element hits an existing one and pushes it along with the same force.
cards.conveys: Makes two motions read as cause and effect. A new piece of information physically displaces the old one.
useWhen: A new ticker headline pushing out the old line.
One card entering and shoving its neighbor aside.
Explaining a new item being inserted into a list.

cards.name: Magnetic Distortion
cards.what: Pixels or a soft blob around a moving touch point are pulled toward it, then spring back.
cards.conveys: Draws the eye to one spot and makes the surface feel like a flexible material.
useWhen: Emphasize where a cursor or finger touches.
Show a jelly-like logo or blob reacting to input.
Pull the whole frame to one point right before a transition.

cards.name: Piece Assembly
cards.what: Loose shapes move and rotate until they lock into a single logo or a gap-free arrangement.
cards.conveys: Shows a whole being made from parts, and the finish lands as a moment of order.
useWhen: A logo outro where the mark completes.
Modules clicking together into one system.
Tiles packing into a seamless layout.

cards.name: Shatter
cards.what: A screen or word cracks into triangular shards that spin apart.
cards.conveys: Conveys destruction, release or a hard break: the old scene shatters and the next one opens.
useWhen: Transition where an old way breaks and a new one appears.
Blow a title apart as it exits.
Reset the screen after a shocking fact.

cards.name: Bend
cards.what: An object is anchored at one end, bends and sways, then springs back.
cards.conveys: Conveys the elasticity and weight of a flexible object. It reads as a bending material, not a stiff plate.
useWhen: Plants, ribbons, thin paper or antennas.
A fixed-end element hit by wind or impact.
Emphasize by bending an object lightly and restoring it.

cards.name: Boolean Path Merge
cards.what: Overlapping shapes join, or their intersection is cut out, forming a single silhouette.
cards.conveys: Makes set relations like union, difference and intersection understandable as forms, showing how two shapes meet.
useWhen: Explain union and intersection in a Venn diagram.
Two logo shapes combining into a new mark.
Show cutting a window or hole out of a shape.

cards.name: Corner Peel
cards.what: One corner of a thin surface curls up at an angle, exposing its back and a soft shadow.
cards.conveys: Gives the feel of paper or a sticker that was stuck down, and hints that something lies beneath.
useWhen: Peel a sticker to show information underneath.
Turn a paper card corner to hint at the next content.
A coupon or scratch card style reveal.

cards.name: Curve Guided Deformation
cards.what: A long object slides along a bent path while bending to match it.
cards.conveys: Shows a flexible transmission path and continuous movement, such as flow along a pipe or a ribbon coiling.
useWhen: Move a ribbon or cable along a curved path.
Have text or a band flow along a curve.

cards.name: Cyclic Position Swap
cards.what: Two or more objects move along arcs into each other's positions.
cards.conveys: Shows that the order changed and who went where, letting viewers trace the permutation and rotation.
useWhen: Swap two cards or items clearly.
Explain a cycle where three or more items shift by one slot.

cards.name: Elastic Mesh
cards.what: Pulling one part of a net drags nearby points along late, then they spring back.
cards.conveys: Shows a connected structure with elasticity, where a change spreads to its neighbors.
useWhen: Show a shock to one node spreading across a network.
A background grid that reacts to the cursor.
A metaphor for connection and propagation in a system.

cards.name: Graded Array Motion
cards.what: Elements get slightly different size or rotation values, forming a fan or gradient array.
cards.conveys: Adds regular rhythm and depth while avoiding monotone repetition, giving a structured, refined impression.
useWhen: For card or icon groups that fan out
To build graphic patterns or backgrounds from many copies of one shape

cards.name: Hinged Oscillation
cards.what: Two parts, like scissors or wings, open and close in opposite directions around the same pivot.
cards.conveys: Lets the viewer understand how the icon works by its structure. The symmetry feels stable and rhythmic.
useWhen: A scissors, pliers or wing icon showing its function.
A quiet idle or waiting state.
Demonstrate how a tool operates in an explainer.

cards.name: Line Tension Loop
cards.what: A line alternates between straight and curved interpolation while its data points stay fixed.
cards.conveys: Explains the difference between interpolation styles.
useWhen: Compare interpolation methods.
Explain the geometry of a fixed data series.

cards.name: Mesh Warp
cards.what: Grid control points move so the whole flat image bends like cloth.
cards.conveys: Makes a large surface feel flexible, turning a rigid photo into a cloth-like material.
useWhen: Make an image ripple like a flag or fabric.
Exaggerate a face or character expression.
Warp the frame just before moving to the next scene.

cards.name: Offset Path
cards.what: A shape's outline grows or shrinks outward by a fixed distance.
cards.conveys: Expansion and contraction keep the form intact, so widening or narrowing the area of influence reads clearly.
useWhen: Widen a selection area or boundary for emphasis.
Concentric outlines spreading like a wave.
Thicken a shell rather than scaling the shape.

cards.name: Outline Then Fill
cards.what: The outline or wireframe appears first, then the interior surfaces and color fill in.
cards.conveys: Shows structure before content, and lets the fill moment carry a sense of completion.
useWhen: Draw an icon or logo, then color it in.
Show the skeleton of a shape diagram first.
Separate planning from confirmed state visually.

cards.name: Path Highlight
cards.what: Only a short bright stretch travels along the full line.
cards.conveys: Shows the direction and flow of a connection without redrawing the line.
useWhen: When showing flow direction in a data pipeline or network
When light should circle the border of a card or panel

cards.name: Perforated Tear
cards.what: A section of a ticket tears along a perforation and drops away while the body stays.
cards.conveys: Communicates that the used part has separated from the body, matching tickets, coupons and receipts.
useWhen: Tear a stub off to mark a ticket as used.
Rip off a coupon or receipt in a scene.
Show part of a card's information detaching.

cards.name: Pivot Relay
cards.what: An element rotates around one corner, then hands the pivot to another corner and settles.
cards.conveys: Shows force and the center of mass shifting. The card seems to steady itself into place.
useWhen: Make a card entrance that flips up on a corner and settles.
Move a shape as if it rolls.
Explain how a center of mass changes.

cards.name: Pucker and Bloat
cards.what: Vertices and curves are pulled in opposite directions, turning a shape into a star or flower.
cards.conveys: Shifts a shape's character between sharp and soft. One rule moves between star and flower.
useWhen: A circle sharpening into a star to suggest a sparkle.
A petal-like swelling icon entrance.
A UI cue where an activated shape becomes sharper.

cards.name: Round Corners
cards.what: Sharp corners of a shape gradually round into curves, or return to sharp corners.
cards.conveys: Shows a change from hard to soft, quietly conveying surface state and flexibility.
useWhen: A square card turning into a button or circle.
A selected element softening as a state change.
The first step of a shape becoming a character.

cards.name: Shape Repeater
cards.what: The same shape multiplies with steady offsets in position, rotation and scale.
cards.conveys: Shows the rhythm and pattern created by repetition, where one rule builds a large structure.
useWhen: Radial patterns or logo decoration.
One shape multiplying into a grid or spiral.
Illustrate regular growth as a concept.

cards.name: Shape Split and Merge
cards.what: One shape splits into several smaller shapes, or several shapes merge into one.
cards.conveys: Shows part-whole relationships, classification and consolidation, explaining what pieces a whole is made of.
useWhen: Explain a whole dividing into three components.
Show several items merging into one category.

cards.name: Skew
cards.what: Slants a shape along an axis to suggest force and speed.
cards.conveys: A tilted form shows the direction of force and speed.
useWhen: When giving speed to a title or bar entering fast
When cards lean and return with scroll speed

cards.name: Soft Body Jiggle
cards.what: A soft mass squashes and jiggles with movement and impact, then returns to a round shape.
cards.conveys: Shows elastic material and the effect of force, giving a cute jelly-like texture.
useWhen: Make a mascot or icon move like jelly.
Add a brief wobble after a collision.

cards.name: Split Logo Reveal
cards.what: A single mark splits apart, reveals a phrase between its halves, then closes again.
cards.conveys: Ties one object to the message it carries. The logo opens and closes around the phrase.
useWhen: Slip a slogan or product name between the halves of a logo.
Open and close a mark on the music beat.
Reveal a call to action in an outro.

cards.name: Tapered Stroke
cards.what: A line's start and end thin out like a brush stroke as it lengthens and shortens.
cards.conveys: Builds direction and speed, and gives a hand-drawn stroke more life than a uniform line.
useWhen: Draw signatures, underlines or arrows with a brush feel.
Trajectories that need a sense of speed.
Stroke decoration around a logo.

cards.name: Traveling Deformation Wave
cards.what: A bend that starts on one side of an object travels to the other side and returns it to its original shape.
cards.conveys: Shows a disturbance or reaction being transmitted. It feels like a touch or signal spreading along the object.
useWhen: Show a signal passing along a line or ribbon.
Give a button press a wave that passes to its neighbors.

cards.name: Zig Zag Path
cards.what: A smooth outline gains repeating sharp points or waves.
cards.conveys: Adds tension and decorative energy. A circle turns into a saw-toothed or wavy edge with strong impact.
useWhen: Serrated edges for badges and stickers.
Outlines for strong messages like warnings, sales or bursts.
Change a soft circle into a wavy border.

cards.name: Shape Built Letters
cards.what: Lines and geometric pieces slide together to complete the strokes and ornaments of letters.
cards.conveys: Treats type as graphic material; the moment the pieces lock together is satisfying and shows creativity.
useWhen: Build a brand word out of shapes as its entrance.
Open with a typographic-poster feel.

cards.name: Text On Path
cards.what: Characters sit along a curved path and travel over it.
cards.conveys: Shows the flow of a curve through the sentence itself, with the path guiding the eye to its end point.
useWhen: Move a caption along a route or trajectory on a map.
Flow a title along a curved logo-like line.

cards.name: Digital Rain
cards.what: Columns of characters fall from the top, each led by a bright head with a fading tail behind it.
cards.conveys: Gives the screen the texture of code and data constantly flowing. It suggests a high volume of information without asking the viewer to read any of it.
useWhen: Build an opening background for AI, hacking or data-processing topics.
Lay a sense of flowing information behind foreground text.

cards.name: Fresnel Rim Sweep
cards.what: An object rotates while its grazing edges brighten and a soft sheen travels across the surface.
cards.conveys: Outlines and material read clearly, and the object feels volumetric rather than flat. It also suggests glass or metal.
useWhen: Show a 3D product or icon turning to bring out its silhouette and material.
Make a shape read instantly against a dark background.

cards.name: Bulge Lens
cards.what: A transparent lens sweeps across an image and bulges only the region beneath it.
cards.conveys: Feels like dragging a glass bead over the picture. The eye follows the lens and the surface gains a physical, tactile quality.
useWhen: Point out details inside an image one after another.
Sweep across a product photo to show surface texture.

cards.name: Caustic Light Ripples
cards.what: A bright net of refracted light drifts, concentrates and disperses as if beneath water or glass.
cards.conveys: Makes the viewer feel the presence of a refracting material. It creates a cool, clear underwater atmosphere.
useWhen: Need a background texture for pool, glass or water themes.
Lay moving water light on the floor beneath a product.

cards.name: CRT Scanlines
cards.what: Fine scanlines, mild curvature, and a moving bright band make the screen look like a CRT monitor.
cards.conveys: Builds retro computer and arcade atmosphere and makes the content feel as if it lives inside a real device.
useWhen: To recreate terminals, arcades, and 90s computer screens
For retro-toned title scenes or tech retrospectives

cards.name: Film Grain
cards.what: A fine layer of grain updated at a low frame rate gives the frame a film texture.
cards.conveys: Softens digital coldness and adds organic texture and a consistent look.
useWhen: To lay a consistent film tone over a whole video
To tame the over-smooth look of AI images and composited shots

cards.name: Glass Refraction
cards.what: A glass panel blurs and refracts the background behind it, rippling as the panel moves.
cards.conveys: Conveys transparent material and depth, and shows the panel floating above the background in the hierarchy.
useWhen: When a card or panel moves over a background and should read as glass
To separate UI layers through material instead of only color

cards.name: RGB Split Glitch
cards.what: Color channels and horizontal slices jitter apart for a moment, then snap back to the original frame.
cards.conveys: Signals digital error and instability and creates a strong emphasis in a very short beat.
useWhen: To hit hard when a title or logo appears
To mark a jarring moment in tech, hacker, or cyber topics

cards.name: God Rays
cards.what: Multiple beams fan out from a light source, sway slowly and pulse in brightness.
cards.conveys: A mysterious, reverent sense of space. Creates a central light and depth in one move.
useWhen: Raise the stakes of a key subject with light streaming from behind it.
Give a dark background depth and a direction of light.

cards.name: Holographic sheen
cards.what: A rainbow sheen slides across a card as the surface angle changes, like a hologram.
cards.conveys: Suggests rarity and premium quality and emphasizes the depth of the surface.
useWhen: To give collectible-style UI like cards, badges, and rewards a premium feel
To show a product surface changing color as it catches light

cards.name: Lamp Cone Reveal
cards.what: Two light cones widen from the top sides and reveal the center line like a stage lamp.
cards.conveys: A signal that this line is the star. A dramatic entrance where one thing is lit in the dark.
useWhen: Introduce a hero title or key line on a dark screen.
Open a section with the feeling of a stage brightening.

cards.name: Light Leak
cards.what: Large warm light blobs drift across the frame and fade out, like a film leak.
cards.conveys: Gives a filmed-memory warmth and soft emotional distance. Placed on a cut, it lets the two scenes flow into each other.
useWhen: For warm texture on recollection, interview, or brand mood shots
To bridge two scenes with light passing across the cut

cards.name: Liquid Metal
cards.what: A silver surface flows viscously while mirror-like reflections keep shifting.
cards.conveys: A cold, futuristic metal feel. The heavy viscosity gives high-tech products presence.
useWhen: Show a logo or title in a liquid metal finish.
Use as the surface behind a high-tech product intro.

cards.name: Palette Color Cycling
cards.what: Pixel positions stay fixed while the palette's color mapping rotates in order, so water or light seems to flow.
cards.conveys: Creates looping movement from a still image and very few frames. It carries the retro texture of 8-bit graphics.
useWhen: Add cheap motion to water, fire or neon in pixel art backgrounds.
Build a retro-game feeling brand screen.

cards.name: Particle Video Mosaic
cards.what: A fixed grid of dots takes its colors from the video frame by frame, redrawing the moving scene as points.
cards.conveys: Shows that video is a collection of tiny units of information. It exposes the resolution and graininess of a digital screen as a stylistic choice.
useWhen: Explain visually that video is built from point-sized data.
Give a transition a dot grid texture that sets a digital tone.

cards.name: Pixel Sorting
cards.what: Pixel rows are pushed by brightness into stretched vertical or horizontal streaks, a glitch-art effect.
cards.conveys: Gives an experimental, provocative impression of an image melting into data.
useWhen: To let an image dissolve into data-like streaks during a transition
For strong texture in music videos or experimental titles

cards.name: Silk Flow
cards.what: Glossy cloth-like folds drift slowly while light and shadow flow along them.
cards.conveys: A soft, premium material feel. It reads as unhurried and luxurious.
useWhen: Backgrounds for calm, high-end brands such as luxury, beauty or fintech.
Fill the space behind a product intro with a gentle grain of light.

cards.name: Topographic contour flow
cards.what: Dense contour lines draw across a deforming surface as height and color drift slowly.
cards.conveys: Reads as a precise, organic terrain map. It suits data landscapes and abstract technical backdrops.
useWhen: Give a static title background a precise, technical texture.
Open a section about terrain, density or distribution.

cards.name: VHS Tracking
cards.what: Horizontal distortion bands and color fringing sweep up the frame, like VHS tape tracking errors.
cards.conveys: Creates worn-tape nostalgia and a retro mood, with the feel of an unstable analog signal.
useWhen: To evoke 80s and 90s home video or retro flashbacks
To mark a switch that feels like playback start or rewind

cards.name: Animated Dithering
cards.what: An image is drawn with limited colors and regular dot patterns, and the color levels animate.
cards.conveys: Brings low-res game and early-computer nostalgia and a distinctive black-and-white texture.
useWhen: To add texture in retro-game, indie, or illustrated brand videos
For a transition where an image comes to life from a dither pattern into full color

cards.name: ASCII Motion
cards.what: An image becomes a grid of brightness-mapped characters, and the grid tightens until it resolves into the original.
cards.conveys: Shows code and terminal aesthetics and the idea that an image is built from data.
useWhen: In dev-tool, AI, or code intros where an image should show as characters
For a transition where characters resolve into the real picture

cards.name: Barrel Lens Warp
cards.what: Straight lines at the screen edge curve and the whole image bulges like a wide-angle lens.
cards.conveys: The presence of a wide field of view and a camera lens. As if the image passed through physical glass.
useWhen: Add a lens feel to a screen recording or UI screenshot.
Add a bulging wide-angle effect just before a transition.

cards.name: Bloom Pulse
cards.what: Soft light spreads around a bright object and then contracts.
cards.conveys: The peak of a hero and its energy. Light blooms and presence grows.
useWhen: When a logo or key object should glow at the climax
When neon or glowing UI should be stressed on the beat

cards.name: Codec Glitch
cards.what: Compression blocks and warped colors appear on screen, smear along the motion direction, then return to the original.
cards.conveys: Shows the texture of digital compression errors and data corruption, good for transitions or impact.
useWhen: For transitions where the picture breaks like a compression error and recovers
To express signal damage in AI or streaming topics

cards.name: Film Dust and Scratches
cards.what: Small dust specks and vertical scratches appear on the frame, then shift position or vanish.
cards.conveys: Builds a sense of time on old film and handmade archive atmosphere.
useWhen: To add worn-film traces to recollection, documentary, or vintage brand shots
To make a clean digital picture look like an analog archive

cards.name: Flame Noise Loop
cards.what: Flame-like noise flickers around an iris or light source while the central hole tracks a gaze.
cards.conveys: A living eye or core full of energy. It breathes life into a still image.
useWhen: Show that an AI eye, core or energy orb is alive.
Hold the gaze on the center during loading or waiting.

cards.name: Flowmap Smear
cards.what: The image bends or smears in the direction of motion, then recovers over time.
cards.conveys: The speed and inertia of a movement left as a mark on the surface, like a cursor trail.
useWhen: Leave a residual distortion on an image where a cursor or touch passed.
Show the speed of a fast-moving object as surface deformation.

cards.name: Fluted Glass Drift
cards.what: Repeated vertical flutes stretch and fold the background as they drift sideways.
cards.conveys: The refined refraction of translucent architectural glass. A veil that filters mood without hiding the information.
useWhen: Filter the backdrop behind a card or panel through fluted glass for a premium look.
Overlay a vertical refraction filter to change an image's mood.

cards.name: Gate Weave
cards.what: The footage shakes with tiny mechanical offsets while exposure brightens and darkens slightly, like film gate weave.
cards.conveys: Builds analog projector trust and texture, and breaks the perfect stillness of digital.
useWhen: To build a film look alongside grain
To make AI shots or stills feel like film frames

cards.name: Scan band
cards.what: A narrow diagonal band passes over the text, and RGB misalignment appears only inside it.
cards.conveys: Feels like a scanner sweeping the text, adding precise, technical emphasis to a title.
useWhen: For an intro where a title is scanned once right after appearing
To scan-highlight a key word

cards.name: Hatch Fill
cards.what: A zigzag scribble travels back and forth inside a shape, filling it as if colored by hand.
cards.conveys: The process of coloring by hand and a friendly sketch texture. Imperfect, so approachable.
useWhen: Emphasize a shape or region as if painting it by hand.
Fill a selected area in a diagram in a sketch style.

cards.name: Ink Bleed
cards.what: Ink blobs bleed into paper, merge, then contract, leaving a crisp letter or mark.
cards.conveys: Shows handmade traces and organic generation, bringing human warmth to a digital screen.
useWhen: To make a title or logo appear as if bleeding like ink wash
To express a human touch in education, publishing, or craft topics

cards.name: Kaleidoscope Motion
cards.what: An image is mirrored into symmetry and its pattern keeps changing as the center rotates.
cards.conveys: Complex symmetry and a dreamlike rhythm. Small material turns into an ornate pattern.
useWhen: Turn an image or logo into a symmetric pattern background.
Provide a fantastical background loop for an opener or music video.

cards.name: Lens Flare
cards.what: A long blue-violet horizontal streak extends from a bright point, with small reflection circles trailing.
cards.conveys: Creates a strong light source and cinematic camera presence, and acts as a visual cue for a bright moment.
useWhen: To create a light peak at a product reveal, logo appearance, or opening title
To let light bloom from a bright point just before a cut

cards.name: Light Sweep
cards.what: A tilted band of light passes once through a giant number and title, only inside the glyphs, like a metallic print sheen.
cards.conveys: The subject feels solid and valuable. The stillness after the light passes reads as a finished, confirmed state.
useWhen: Present a big number, logo, or cover title as settled.
Give a static title card a single moment of life.

cards.name: Line Boil
cards.what: Hand-drawn lines jitter slightly at a low frame rate so they look alive.
cards.conveys: Gives the imperfect vitality of hand-made animation and a sketch texture.
useWhen: To bring still lines to life in hand-drawn diagrams or doodle-style explainers
For background lines in sketch-toned brand videos

cards.name: Motion Blur
cards.what: Multiple samples along the direction of motion are blended to add blur to fast-moving objects.
cards.conveys: Adds the speed and smooth continuity a real camera shutter produces, and reduces digital stutter.
useWhen: To add speed to titles or icons that snap in quickly
When low frame rate makes motion look choppy

cards.name: Moving Light
cards.what: A light source moves, changing the bright side of an object and the shadow direction together.
cards.conveys: Shows the object's volume and the passage of time, adding depth to a static scene.
useWhen: To emphasize volume as light passes over a product or card
To express time passing through changing shadow direction

cards.name: Negative Space Inversion
cards.what: The silhouette stays the same while the bright shape and dark space swap roles.
cards.conveys: The sense that perspective or circumstance has flipped for the same subject: figure and ground trade places.
useWhen: Show opposite states of the same subject, like before and after or problem and solution.
Link scenes through a logo or icon silhouette.

cards.name: Particle Painting Advection
cards.what: Short brush marks carrying the image's colors move along a flow field and scatter the picture like a painting.
cards.conveys: A still image turning into fluid oil paint. The moment photography passes into art.
useWhen: Stage the moment a photo turns into a painting.
Build an intro where an image scatters and then reassembles.

cards.name: Polar Coordinates Wrap
cards.what: A horizontally laid-out image rolls into a circular band, or unrolls back.
cards.conveys: The correspondence between a line and a circle as the same information. Makes cycles and periodicity visible.
useWhen: Show a time-axis bar transforming into a radial chart.
Turn a horizontal strip into a radial structure to reveal periodicity.

cards.name: Progressive Blur
cards.what: Blur grows toward the content edge so moving content fades away smoothly.
cards.conveys: Edges melt away instead of being cut hard, focusing attention on the central information.
useWhen: Smooth the edge where a scrolling list slides behind a header or bottom bar.
Blur the surroundings to create focus on the central content.

cards.name: Raindrop Glass
cards.what: Background appears magnified inside drops on the glass as drops merge and run down.
cards.conveys: The mood of a rainy window and wet surfaces. Calm emotion and a sense of distance.
useWhen: Show a city or scene beyond a rainy window emotionally.
Add a droplet texture to product glass or a screen for freshness.

cards.name: Ripple Distortion
cards.what: A circular ripple passes over the screen, briefly changing surrounding color and shape, then settles.
cards.conveys: Shows click or activation feedback with material feel, as if the screen responds like water.
useWhen: To show a response as a ripple at a click, activation, or landing point
For an image transition where waves sweep across the screen

cards.name: Slit Scan
cards.what: Each row or column is sampled at a different time so the image stretches and curves like a wave.
cards.conveys: Makes time unfold across space in a surreal way and evokes cosmic, stargate-like atmosphere.
useWhen: For surreal transitions or time-warp scenes
To erase a person or logo through time distortion in a memorable way

cards.name: Strobe Flash
cards.what: Color or texture frames swap repeatedly at short beat intervals, then settle at the end.
cards.conveys: Pushes rhythm and energy visually and creates a montage beat that sweeps through several sources fast.
useWhen: To swap images or color frames rapidly to a music beat
For an opening that scans four sources and lands on one

cards.name: Temporal Wiggle
cards.what: Noise is added to a motion's playback time so its speed wobbles back and forth irregularly.
cards.conveys: Mechanically even motion becomes unstable and organic, like hand-driven or analog footage.
useWhen: Add a hand-made feel to overly smooth repeating motion.
Create a rough stop-motion or low-frame-rate rhythm.

cards.name: Text Light Rays
cards.what: Colored-edge rays stretch from the letter shapes toward a moving light point.
cards.conveys: Gives a title dramatic weight as if the letters emit light, and adds volume.
useWhen: Trailer-style title reveals
Openings where light leaks from behind the letters

cards.name: Animated Texture Fill
cards.what: A texture image moves or swaps frame by frame inside a fixed shape mask.
cards.conveys: Gives letters or shapes a living material feel while keeping the shape itself fixed.
useWhen: To make video or texture flow inside large title letters
To give shaped badges or logos a material feel

cards.name: Turbulent Displace
cards.what: Pixels and outlines slosh along a flowing irregular pattern, then restore.
cards.conveys: Expresses air rippling like heat haze or being underwater, and an unstable moment.
useWhen: For transitions into dream, memory, heat, or underwater scenes
To make outlines waver before a title appears or as it disappears

cards.name: Twirl Distortion
cards.what: Footage around a center twists and curls like a whirlpool.
cards.conveys: Rotational energy and warped space. A feeling of being pulled in or of memory blurring.
useWhen: Curl a scene into a spiral to hand off to the next.
Give flashbacks or dream transitions a twisted sense of space.

cards.name: Velocity Skew
cards.what: The faster you scroll, the more letters and cards skew; when it stops they return to their shape.
cards.conveys: Shows speed as material deformation and gives scroll or movement a physical sense of inertia.
useWhen: For cards or titles that react to scroll speed
To give a stretched feel of inertia after fast movement

cards.name: Water Surface Refraction
cards.what: The image wobbles beneath ripples while bright facets of the waves travel across it.
cards.conveys: The feel of being underwater or on a wet surface. A cool, calm shimmer.
useWhen: Bring water-related images such as pools, seas or drinks to life.
Give flashbacks or dream transitions a scene-beyond-ripples feel.

cards.name: Wave Warp
cards.what: Letter outlines bend and sway like a sine wave while the sentence stays in place.
cards.conveys: Gives text the vibration of water, sound, or heat and makes it feel alive.
useWhen: For titles in sound or voice scenes that need a sense of vibration
To render text on water or in heat haze

cards.name: Gooey Text Morph
cards.what: One word blobs into liquid and re-forms as the next word.
cards.conveys: An organic shift of language, as if two words were one substance.
useWhen: Smoothly linking a slogan swap between two words
An emotional phrase transition in a brand film

cards.name: Neon Sign Flicker
cards.what: A glowing sign's brightness and halo cut in and out irregularly.
cards.conveys: Evokes night signage and electricity; the unstable switch-on builds tension in the entrance.
useWhen: Title a night-city, bar, or cyber-mood scene.
Give a title a 'switching on' entrance.

cards.name: Text Echo Trail
cards.what: Delayed text copies trail behind a moving phrase and fade out.
cards.conveys: Speed and trajectory become visible, so the phrase reads as fast.
useWhen: Adding speed to a title that slides in quickly
A phrase crossing the frame at a transition

cards.name: Text Liquid Distortion
cards.what: Stroke edges and interiors bend and ripple with noise.
cards.conveys: Fluid, unstable, and alive, like letters underwater.
useWhen: Emotional scenes where the title ripples in or out
Expressing tension before a change through the text itself

cards.name: Text Slice Offset
cards.what: Parallel bands of a word shift in alternating directions.
cards.conveys: Segmentation and mechanical distortion, like a data error or a scan.
useWhen: A brief jolt when a title arrives or a scene changes
Depicting errors, noise or signal faults through text

cards.name: Seek and Arrive
cards.what: An agent turns toward a target and slows down as it approaches.
cards.conveys: Shows goal-directed behavior and the relationship between stopping distance and speed.
useWhen: Explain how an autonomous agent approaches a target.
Show a pointer or robot slowing down near its destination.

cards.name: Text Particle Dissolve
cards.what: Text breaks into small particles and fades after submission.
cards.conveys: Shows that input has been sent or processed.
useWhen: Use this effect when you need to communicate: Shows that input has been sent or processed.
Connect interaction states within a product demonstration.

cards.name: Domain Warping
cards.what: A shader background made by warping noise with more noise, organic and endlessly flowing.
cards.conveys: Adds living, liquid depth and a quiet high-tech mood across the whole screen.
useWhen: To lay a living abstract texture under a hero or intro
To add low-intensity motion to a title scene with a dull flat background

cards.name: Fluid Ink Advection
cards.what: Colored ink spreads and swirls in water, blending softly.
cards.conveys: Ideas bleeding into one another and energy in flow. A creative, fluid mood.
useWhen: Visualize flowing, mixing concepts such as creativity or generative AI.
Fill the space between scenes with a surface of bleeding color.

cards.name: Fractal Clouds
cards.what: Soft cloud masses drift slowly and change shape.
cards.conveys: A wide open space and calm. The unhurried passing of time.
useWhen: Fill a sky, nature or cloud-themed background quietly.
Provide a quietly moving backdrop behind text-heavy scenes.

cards.name: Neuro Noise Veins
cards.what: Thin bright lines and valleys keep folding and spreading into a web like neurons or veins.
cards.conveys: Suggests a living signal network and complex activity. It builds an intelligent, organic backdrop without carrying exact information.
useWhen: Set a cover or section background for AI, neural or network topics.
Add a low-contrast moving texture when a flat background feels empty.

cards.name: Particle Burst
cards.what: Particles explode outward from a single point, fall under gravity, and fade out.
cards.conveys: Shows the energy of a success or completion moment and gathers the eye at that spot.
useWhen: To mark an achievement like a click, payment done, or goal reached
To add an explosive accent where a logo or number appears

cards.name: Particle image reveal
cards.what: Scattered particles gather into the shape and color of an image and reveal it.
cards.conveys: Suggests something assembled from fragments and gives a logo or image a dramatic entrance.
useWhen: To reveal a logo or product image dramatically in an intro
To have particles converge into the next scene during a transition

cards.name: Particle Vortex
cards.what: Particles spiral toward or away from a center in a vortex.
cards.conveys: Focus being drawn in or spreading outward. A signal that something sits at the center.
useWhen: Show many elements converging on one core.
Use a particle flow as the central visual of a loading or transformation moment.

cards.name: Shooting Stars
cards.what: Thin light trails streak diagonally and fade out like meteors.
cards.conveys: Night sky and space atmosphere, a brief burst of energy that adds life to a background.
useWhen: Add small motion to backgrounds themed on space, night or AI.
Give a static dark backdrop an occasional glance-catching moment.

cards.name: Smoke Ring Vortex
cards.what: Smoke curls inside a doughnut-shaped ring while its outer edge wobbles slightly.
cards.conveys: Suggests a force circulating within the ring and a mysterious mood. It works as a quiet backdrop that hints at an opening or a cycle.
useWhen: Wrap a soft ring of light around a logo or title.
Show a mysterious or generating state through the background.

cards.name: Spiral Field Rotation
cards.what: A continuous spiral pattern radiates from the center and rotates so it seems to flow inward or outward.
cards.conveys: Draws the eye to the center and suggests being pulled in. It conveys immersion, cycles or a hypnotic state through the background alone.
useWhen: Gather attention on a central title or logo.
Express immersion or circulation in a background.

cards.name: Beam Collision Burst
cards.what: A falling beam bursts into small light fragments the instant it hits the floor or a boundary.
cards.conveys: The impact of a movement ending as an event. Emphasizes arrival and confirmation.
useWhen: Announce with a burst that data or a request has reached its target.
Use a falling line hitting the floor as the pivot that opens the next scene.

cards.name: Boid Flocking
cards.what: Small agents keep their distance, align heading and turn together as one flock.
cards.conveys: Individual rules producing collective movement. Coordination with no one in charge.
useWhen: Visualize self-organization, emergence and multi-agent ideas.
Create a backdrop that suggests agents cooperating.

cards.name: Branch Growth
cards.what: A trunk splits into branches, smaller branches split again, and the structure grows.
cards.conveys: Shows growth, expansion, and hierarchy intuitively, a metaphor for a tree or network reaching outward.
useWhen: To explain hierarchies where organizations, knowledge, or features branch out
To draw a background diagram as a metaphor for growth or expansion

cards.name: Cellular Automaton Evolution
cards.what: Grid cells switch on and off by neighbor state, and patterns grow or drift.
cards.conveys: Small local rules producing large patterns. Complexity arising from simplicity.
useWhen: Explain emergence, life or rule-based systems.
Lay a slowly growing pattern over a grid background.

cards.name: Differential galaxy
cards.what: Inner stars orbit faster than outer ones, so spiral arms wind up over time.
cards.conveys: Shows the spiral structure produced by differential rotation and gives a sense of scale and cosmic awe.
useWhen: For backgrounds that metaphorize space, data scale, or network growth
To explain speed differences between inner and outer parts

cards.name: Differential Line Growth
cards.what: A short line or loop keeps lengthening, wrinkling and folding to fill the available space.
cards.conveys: Shows the pressure of growth in a limited space and organic form. It recalls brain folds and leaf veins.
useWhen: Use organic growth as a background or cover graphic.
Visualize the metaphor of growth folding against its limits.

cards.name: Diffusion Limited Aggregation
cards.what: Wandering points stick where they touch the existing cluster, growing thin, irregular branches outward.
cards.conveys: Shows that accumulation and chance build structure. It conveys the growth logic behind lightning, coral and crystal branching.
useWhen: Explain how branching forms arise, as in coral, lightning or crystals.
Back a theme of complex form from simple rules.

cards.name: Eden Boundary Growth
cards.what: New cells attach to the outer boundary of a small cluster, growing a round mass with few gaps.
cards.conveys: Shows uniform proliferation and territory expansion. It works as a metaphor for cell division or market share growth.
useWhen: Show spreading cells or communities with a simple rule.
Express territorial expansion as a backdrop for a data story.

cards.name: Electric Arc
cards.what: Irregular branching bright lines flash between points or outlines and vanish quickly.
cards.conveys: Signals energy, impact, and connection strongly, and gives words a striking feel.
useWhen: To emphasize a key word as if struck by lightning
To mark the moment an energy link forms between two nodes

cards.name: Fire Plume
cards.what: Bright particles rise, sway and gradually fade at the edges like a column of fire.
cards.conveys: Heat, energy and upward force. A screen where hot air feels alive.
useWhen: Create a hot visual anchor for topics like energy, passion or warning.
Show fire burning beneath a logo or icon.

cards.name: Firework Bloom
cards.what: A rising light bursts into many strands in the air, and glowing trails fade.
cards.conveys: A climax and a feeling of release. A signal that announces an achievement or celebration loudly.
useWhen: Build the climax for a goal reached, a launch or the end of an event.
Add a celebratory feel across the frame just before a transition.

cards.name: Flow Field
cards.what: Many small particles and trails move along curves following an invisible flow.
cards.conveys: Visualizes invisible forces like wind, water, or data flow, with an elegant generative-art feel.
useWhen: To lay an organic generative texture behind titles or brand videos
To show the directionality of wind, currents, or data flow

cards.name: Fractal Zoom
cards.what: Continuously zoom into a recomputed fractal to reveal repeating structure and new detail.
cards.conveys: Conveys self-similarity and an extending sense of scale.
useWhen: Explain self-similarity.
Suggest scale through repeating structure.

cards.name: Halftone Motion
cards.what: A grid of dots whose size follows brightness and moves in waves or scans.
cards.conveys: Brings a printed, pop-art graphic texture and adds rhythm to a still image.
useWhen: For print-flavored or pop-art backgrounds and title cards
For transitions where dot size makes the image appear and vanish

cards.name: Metaball
cards.what: Round blobs grow necks and fuse as they approach, then separate again as they move apart.
cards.conveys: Shows soft organic connection and division, a metaphor for individual pieces becoming one.
useWhen: To show elements merging or splitting like liquid
To give loaders, menu buttons, and logo intros a sticky material feel

cards.name: N-body Orbital Cluster
cards.what: Many points attract one another and form small clusters and orbiting groups.
cards.conveys: Structure created by interaction and gravity. Scattered things gather themselves into an arrangement.
useWhen: Explain stars, galaxies, clustering and self-organization.
Use as a metaphor for scattered points pulling together into clusters.

cards.name: Packing Relaxation
cards.what: Scattered circles push each other and adjust size until they settle into an overlap-free layout.
cards.conveys: Shows the process of order emerging from chaos and makes data distribution and space allocation intuitive.
useWhen: To show bubble charts or category shares being laid out without overlap
As a metaphor for a random distribution organizing into structure

cards.name: Particle Scatter & Assemble
cards.what: Hundreds of particles floating across the frame fly in and assemble into one large number.
cards.conveys: Scattered pieces converging into a single answer, showing data resolving into a conclusion in one shot.
useWhen: Reveal a key number or logo at full scale in an opening shot.
Show scattered samples converging into one result figure.
Set up a chapter number after a transition.

cards.name: Particle Force Field
cards.what: Particles feel attraction, repulsion, and rotation forces, curving around a center and leaving trails.
cards.conveys: Visualizes unseen forces to explain gravity or magnetic fields, and works as a lively background.
useWhen: To explain gravity, magnetism, attraction, and repulsion
For intro backgrounds with a force center

cards.name: Particle Fountain
cards.what: Particles shoot up from a narrow floor outlet and fall in parabolic arcs.
cards.conveys: Continuous supply and jetting. Resources or activity that keep flowing out.
useWhen: Show data, traffic or tokens flowing out continuously.
Build an intro where energy rises from a single point on the floor.

cards.name: Particle Life Clusters
cards.what: Particles of several colors attract and repel by color, forming membrane-wrapped clusters or chasing blobs.
cards.conveys: Shows that different relationship rules create complex collective behavior, reminiscent of cells and ecosystems.
useWhen: Use as a diagram background to explain emergence or self-organization.
Feature the particle system itself as the subject.

cards.name: Connected Particle Network
cards.what: Moving dots connect with nearby ones by lines that vanish as they drift apart.
cards.conveys: A network where relationships keep forming and changing. The classic metaphor for connectivity and data flow.
useWhen: Build a hero background themed on AI, networks or connection.
Abstractly show relations forming and breaking between nodes.

cards.name: Physarum Trail Network
cards.what: Many agents follow the trails left by earlier ones, and the paths that remain thicken into a connected network.
cards.conveys: Suggests that distributed searching produces efficient paths and organic structure. It recalls mycelium, veins and transit maps.
useWhen: Explain or allude to a network organizing itself.
Create a life-like network background.

cards.name: Rain Streaks
cards.what: Thin lines fall fast in one direction and leave small marks on the ground.
cards.conveys: Weather, speed and tension. Intensity is controlled by density, from a quiet drizzle to a downpour.
useWhen: Build a gloomy or tense atmosphere behind a scene.
Make a cinematic intro such as a rainy city at night.

cards.name: Random Walk
cards.what: Dots repeat short random steps, leaving irregular trails.
cards.conveys: Exploration, uncertainty and diffusion. Where each goes is unknown, yet over time they spread out.
useWhen: Explain diffusion, search or random processes conceptually.
Visualize Brownian motion in a statistics or physics lesson.

cards.name: Reaction Diffusion Growth
cards.what: Small blobs spread, split and settle into stripes or a maze-like pattern.
cards.conveys: Shows that small local reactions between neighbors build a global pattern. It suits explaining how natural markings grow.
useWhen: Explain how local rules create whole patterns, as in animal coats, coral or fingerprints.
Let an abstract, life-like texture grow over time behind content.

cards.name: Rigid Body Cascade
cards.what: Many balls or boxes fall under gravity, collide, bounce and pile up on the floor.
cards.conveys: Real weight and impact. Chance yet natural stacking from many bodies.
useWhen: Show many items pouring in and piling up, such as stock, alerts or data fragments.
Lead pieces resting on the floor into a logo or title after a transition.

cards.name: Rising Bubbles
cards.what: Translucent circles rise from below, sway, grow and fade away.
cards.conveys: Lightness and buoyancy in liquid. A fresh, clear mood.
useWhen: Lightly fill a background about water, drinks or cleanliness.
Give a loading or idle screen a soft upward motion.

cards.name: Smoke Plume
cards.what: Soft blobs rise, grow, overlap and thin out into smoke.
cards.conveys: Evaporation, disappearance and atmospheric drift. A lingering feeling of something vanishing or being cleared away.
useWhen: Add an afterglow when something disappears or is burned away.
Layer smoke over heat or fire to add depth.

cards.name: Spark Spray
cards.what: Small bright dots fly outward, leave short tails and go out.
cards.conveys: Collision, friction and a brief release of energy.
useWhen: When emphasizing the moment two objects collide
When a welding, switch or electric contact spark is needed

cards.name: Strange Attractor Trails
cards.what: Many points loop through complex 3D orbits, drawing rings and overlapping bands.
cards.conveys: Dynamics where order and chaos coexist. Complex form born from a simple equation.
useWhen: Build a visual anchor for chaos, math or complex systems.
Use an intricate orbital pattern as the opener background for a technical talk.

cards.name: Tendril Wave
cards.what: Thin tendrils radiate from a center and bend and straighten in staggered phases.
cards.conveys: Flexible, living repetition like marine life or plants. A radial sense of life.
useWhen: Build a hero object or logo backdrop for an AI, life or organism concept.
Replace a loading indicator with an organic radial motion.

cards.name: Animated Voronoi
cards.what: Irregular cells and crack patterns flow while changing size and shape.
cards.conveys: Organic tissue like cells, crystals or foam. An abstract surface that feels alive.
useWhen: Build abstract backgrounds for biology, materials or network topics.
Use cell borders to show regions splitting and merging.

cards.name: Wave Interference
cards.what: Grid dots move with different sine phases, creating bright nodes and empty regions.
cards.conveys: Shows complex order from simple rules and makes sound and wave interference intuitive.
useWhen: To explain waves, resonance, or signal interference
To build a geometric, meditative background loop

cards.name: Particle Filled Text
cards.what: Small dots inside letter shapes keep moving while still forming the strokes.
cards.conveys: A living swarm forms the phrase, like data or organisms.
useWhen: Rendering an AI, data or life-themed title as particles
Opening-logo style titles in brand films

cards.name: Rotating Globe Connections
cards.what: A globe rotates slowly as connection arcs appear between geographic locations.
cards.conveys: Communicates international reach and geographic connections.
useWhen: Reveal connections between regional offices.
Show a global delivery network with geographic endpoints.

cards.name: Card Flip
cards.what: A card rotates 180 degrees around its vertical or horizontal axis to swap front for back.
cards.conveys: Shows that one object has another side or state. Because the same card turns over, the change reads as continuous rather than a cut.
useWhen: Flip a question card to reveal the answer.
Contrast two states of one object, such as before and after.
Move from a product card's name on the front to its specs on the back.

cards.name: Depth Assemble
cards.what: Elements scattered in 3D space, each tilted and spinning, converge one after another into their exact flat positions.
cards.conveys: Shows order emerging from chaos, or a whole being built from parts, with a sense of space.
useWhen: Scattered idea cards settling into one structure diagram.
Title fragments coming together into a phrase.
Several sources locking into a dashboard layout.

cards.name: Object Turntable
cards.what: A product or 3D object turns on a fixed axis to show its front, sides and back in turn.
cards.conveys: Lets the viewer understand the full form and surface materials, filling in the back that a single camera angle hides.
useWhen: Show the whole shape in a product hero shot.
Present an app by mapping its screen onto a device.
Look closely at one object in a catalog.

cards.name: Portal Reveal
cards.what: A glowing opening appears and the subject passes through its edge toward the viewer.
cards.conveys: Creates the sense of entering another world or feature. It explains where the subject came from inside the frame.
useWhen: A dramatic entrance for a new feature or character.
Move to another space through a single doorway.
Bring a hero logo out of darkness.

cards.name: Text Extrusion
cards.what: The same letters are stacked, their back layers spread along depth and the group turns slightly to reveal a thick side.
cards.conveys: Adds mass and physical presence to a large headline. A flat word becomes a solid object.
useWhen: Give weight to an opening title or chapter heading.
Introduce a brand wordmark in 3D.
Make one word the decisive keyword.

cards.name: Tile Flip
cards.what: Small tiles across a headline flip like a wave to reveal the text on their other face.
cards.conveys: A big message change is broken into small physical units, so the change is easy to follow.
useWhen: Change a slogan into another phrase.
Give a mechanical departure-board feel to changing values.
Add rhythm to a title transition.

cards.name: Wave Carousel
cards.what: Angular boxes travel along a wave and each takes its turn at the front.
cards.conveys: Shows content circulating on a physical structure, reading as a connected set rather than a flat list.
useWhen: Rotate eight service cards through one scene.
Cycle a feature list on a 3D structure.
Sweep a portfolio in one continuous shot.

cards.name: Animated Lighting
cards.what: The color and intensity of light on a 3D object change, revealing different parts of it.
cards.conveys: Form and mood shift with the lighting alone, and the lit areas decide where to look.
useWhen: Sweep light across a product model's contours.
Change mood from cool to warm.
Reveal a subject as if switching on a light in the dark.

cards.name: Atmospheric Depth
cards.what: Distant objects look hazy and faint in fog, then sharpen as they come closer.
cards.conveys: Makes distance between layers readable and gives the scene depth. Foreground information comes first while the back recedes.
useWhen: Stack background layers for a deep hero.
Let a subject sharpen as the camera advances.
Push out-of-focus layers back to emphasize the subject.

cards.name: Camera Fly-through
cards.what: A camera flies through seven planes spaced 900px apart and stops on the final keyword.
cards.conveys: Depth and forward momentum through successive information layers.
useWhen: Travel through layers of information to reach a conclusion.
Show forward progress from input to output.

cards.name: 3D Card Flip Stack
cards.what: Five overlapping paper sheets flip in sequence and stack behind a frontal final card.
cards.conveys: A sequence advances and leaves the final selection in focus.
useWhen: Reveal the result of a five-step sequence.
Show selection by turning editorial paper sheets.

cards.name: Corner Pin
cards.what: The four corners of a plane move, tilting the image into a perspective shape.
cards.conveys: Makes a screen or sign feel attached to a surface in space. Used to seat images in device mockups or wall ads.
useWhen: Fit a screenshot into a device mockup with correct perspective.
Tilt a poster or screen from flat into perspective as it appears.

cards.name: Coverflow
cards.what: Cards travel along a curved arrangement: the center card faces front and large, side cards tilt away and shrink.
cards.conveys: Shows the depth difference between the selected item and its neighbors, so what is current and what is next are distinct.
useWhen: Browse albums, products or templates.
Preview the next item while guiding sequence.
Explain choosing one from several candidates.

cards.name: Deep Multi-layer Parallax
cards.what: A horizontal camera move reveals depth through seven independently paced editorial layers.
cards.conveys: Stable distant planes and fast foreground motion communicate spatial depth.
useWhen: Move attention across a wide editorial canvas.
Give flat information a clear sense of depth.

cards.name: Depth Card Flyby
cards.what: Stacked cards roll forward one by one while the passed card tumbles toward the camera.
cards.conveys: Creates a quickening rhythm as items swap, with depth as cards sweep past the lens.
useWhen: Introduce five cards in a row on the beat.
A fast feature sweep for short-form video.
Tighten cut spacing toward a climax.

cards.name: Dynamic Reflection
cards.what: When surrounding objects or lights move, the reflection inside a mirror-like surface moves with them.
cards.conveys: Shows the spatial relationship between the reflective surface and its surroundings, building trust that the object sits in real space.
useWhen: Show a metal or glass product turning under surrounding lights.
Let another object's movement appear in a reflective surface.

cards.name: Exploded Assembly
cards.what: A product's parts separate along an axis to reveal its internal structure, then gather back into one body.
cards.conveys: Helps viewers understand structure inside the exterior and how parts relate, and shows what goes where in order.
useWhen: Explain the component makeup inside a product.
Guide an assembly order step by step.

cards.name: Hard Shadow Pop
cards.what: An element shifts a little diagonally while a stepped, hard-edged shadow grows behind it.
cards.conveys: Adds print-like thickness and depth. A blur-free shadow feels solid and graphic.
useWhen: Give a headline or button a pop-art thickness.
Emphasize a sticker or badge label.
Casual, upbeat short-form captions.

cards.name: Image Unroll
cards.what: A rolled-up image surface unfurls and settles as a flat picture.
cards.conveys: Gives a hidden surface a sense of material as it opens, like unrolling a poster or scroll.
useWhen: Unfurl a poster, map or photo.
Open an image gallery's first picture dramatically.
Introduce documents or scrolls.

cards.name: Layer Separation
cards.what: Stacked flat layers spread out at different depths and angles, then fold back together.
cards.conveys: Reveals that the screen is built from layers, decomposing it before explaining each layer's role.
useWhen: Explain the background, content and overlay layers of a UI screenshot.
Show the layered structure of components in 3D.

cards.name: Noise Blob
cards.what: A sphere's surface bulges and twists unevenly, continually changing shape.
cards.conveys: Expresses organic life and an abstract material. Suits intangible presences such as AI or creatures.
useWhen: Represent an AI assistant or voice interface as an abstract presence.
Place a slowly morphing 3D object behind a cover.

cards.name: Paper Crumple
cards.what: Flat paper folds along several creases into a small ball, then opens back out.
cards.conveys: Makes disposal, compression or failure a physical event, and turns into recovery when it reopens.
useWhen: Crumple a draft or a failed idea.
Show a document being compressed.
Tell a story of a crumpled sheet being restored.

cards.name: Perspective Flatten
cards.what: A screen that starts tilted and small rotates flat to face the viewer and grows.
cards.conveys: Turns a 3D-looking object into a readable information surface, moving focus to its content as the tilt resolves.
useWhen: Introduce an app screen from a tilted pose to front-on.
A preview card flattening into the main view as you scroll.
Enlarge a product capture into a hero reveal.

cards.name: Perspective Grid Drift
cards.what: Grid lines converging toward the horizon flow forward toward the viewer.
cards.conveys: Gives the feeling of moving through a wide virtual space, with a retro-futuristic mood and steady forward motion.
useWhen: Add space and speed to an opening background.
The floor for a neon or retro toned video.
A quiet looping background behind text.

cards.name: Perspective Panel Rotation
cards.what: Long panels of different colors rotate around a central axis, fanning out at an angle with near faces appearing larger.
cards.conveys: Adds structure and depth to a background through rhythm and division, like a polished stage.
useWhen: Put a moving color panel backdrop behind a product intro or title.
Create a sense of stage or exhibition space with the background alone.

cards.name: Pop-up Book
cards.what: A book's pages open and folded paper structures rise up to form a scene.
cards.conveys: Gives the feeling of a world being built before the viewer's eyes. Suits story openings and chapter starts.
useWhen: Open a chapter with a book opening and building its scene.
Introduce a city or room as a paper structure.

cards.name: Screen Emergence
cards.what: A tilted device screen flattens to face front, then the content inside scales up beyond the frame.
cards.conveys: Shifts the star from the device shell to the content inside, making clear what is really being shown.
useWhen: Move focus from a laptop or phone mockup to the app screen.
Reveal what is inside a device as the page scrolls.
Cut from hardware to software in a product intro.

cards.name: Shadow Elevation
cards.what: As an object rises off the surface, its shadow widens and fades, revealing how high it floats.
cards.conveys: Gives a selected object a sense of height and quietly signals importance or interaction state.
useWhen: Select or lift a card.
Show a button hover state.
Show the height change when a drag starts and ends.

cards.name: Spherize
cards.what: A flat image bulges in the middle as if wrapped around a sphere.
cards.conveys: Delivers the surprise of a flat surface turning into a solid. Useful for screen-to-object transitions.
useWhen: Transition an image into a globe or marble.
Add a convex lens emphasis to a flat screen.

cards.name: Starfield Warp
cards.what: Stars near the center stream outward in perspective, stretching into long streaks of light.
cards.conveys: Creates fast forward motion and a jump through space, giving a leap into a new scene.
useWhen: Launch the scene before a new chapter or product reveal.
A space or tech themed opening background.
Accelerate then decelerate into a landing.

cards.name: Letter Flip Reveal
cards.what: Text lying flat tips up on a horizontal or vertical axis to reveal its front face.
cards.conveys: Letters seem to stand up in space, giving a title depth and weight.
useWhen: When a single short title should arrive with dimensional weight
For section-opening titles

cards.name: Text On 3D Surface
cards.what: Phrases wrap around a cylinder or ring and rotate so the front-facing phrase keeps changing.
cards.conveys: Presents repeated information as a continuous 3D structure and builds space with depth-rich rotation.
useWhen: Cycle through a list of phrases in one rotation.
Give a brand intro a dimensional typographic backdrop.

cards.name: Walk Cycle
cards.what: A rigged character alternates its arms and legs in a repeating walk.
cards.conveys: Communicates character activity and locomotion.
useWhen: Show a character traveling.
Use an in-place walk to indicate activity.

cards.name: Arc Spinner
cards.what: A rotating arc alternately lengthens and shortens.
cards.conveys: Signals unfinished processing without a completion estimate.
useWhen: Use when presenting arc spinner in a waiting or ambient scene.
Use for a compact status indicator with a stable surrounding layout.

cards.name: Breathing Loop
cards.what: A resting element repeats subtle scale and position changes.
cards.conveys: Keeps an idle scene feeling alive.
useWhen: Use when presenting breathing loop in a waiting or ambient scene.
Use for a compact status indicator with a stable surrounding layout.

cards.name: Float Loop
cards.what: An element gently bobs up and down.
cards.conveys: Conveys lightness and an idle state.
useWhen: Use when presenting float loop in a waiting or ambient scene.
Use for a compact status indicator with a stable surrounding layout.

cards.name: Indeterminate Progress
cards.what: A bright bar repeatedly sweeps across a clipped track.
cards.conveys: Shows activity when the completion percentage is unknown.
useWhen: Use when presenting indeterminate progress in a waiting or ambient scene.
Use for a compact status indicator with a stable surrounding layout.

cards.name: Loading Dots
cards.what: Dots bounce or pulse with staggered phases.
cards.conveys: Signals that a reply is still being prepared.
useWhen: Use when presenting loading dots in a waiting or ambient scene.
Use for a compact status indicator with a stable surrounding layout.

cards.name: Marquee
cards.what: Duplicated content flows continuously across the viewport.
cards.conveys: Suggests an ongoing stream and activity.
useWhen: Use when presenting marquee in a waiting or ambient scene.
Use for a compact status indicator with a stable surrounding layout.

cards.name: Ripple Rings
cards.what: Concentric rings expand and fade from a shared center.
cards.conveys: Communicates a spreading signal or a call for attention.
useWhen: Use when presenting ripple rings in a waiting or ambient scene.
Use for a compact status indicator with a stable surrounding layout.

cards.name: Skeleton Shimmer
cards.what: A bright band travels across muted content placeholders.
cards.conveys: Shows where content will arrive and that loading is in progress.
useWhen: Indicate that card data is loading.
Preview the layout of content that is still loading.

cards.name: Spin Loop
cards.what: A gear, pointer, or loader rotates around a fixed center.
cards.conveys: Suggests ongoing operation and passing time.
useWhen: Use when presenting spin loop in a waiting or ambient scene.
Use for a compact status indicator with a stable surrounding layout.

cards.name: Stroke Chase
cards.what: A short illuminated segment travels around an outline.
cards.conveys: Maintains a visible working state.
useWhen: Use when presenting stroke chase in a waiting or ambient scene.
Use for a compact status indicator with a stable surrounding layout.

cards.name: Wiggle
cards.what: A continuous, irregular jitter in position or rotation.
cards.conveys: Unease, energy, or a hand-made sense of life in the smallest motion.
useWhen: When a still element needs a little liveliness
When showing a nervous character or a camera shake

cards.name: Ambient Glow
cards.what: A blurred multicolor light shifts and brightens behind a surface.
cards.conveys: Creates warm depth and a sense of continuing activity.
useWhen: Add a soft breathing backlight behind a product card.
Use a short repeating motion to communicate creates warm depth and a sense of continuing activity.

cards.name: Ambient Particle Drift
cards.what: Small, faint particles drift at different speeds.
cards.conveys: Adds life and depth without competing with text.
useWhen: Bring quiet life to empty space.
Suggest depth in a background.

cards.name: Bar Wave Loader
cards.what: Adjacent bars rise and fall in a staggered wave.
cards.conveys: Suggests signal processing and a steady work rhythm.
useWhen: Indicate that voice processing is active.
Use a short repeating motion to communicate suggests signal processing and a steady work rhythm.

cards.name: Chasing Dots
cards.what: Dots orbit together while their sizes change with phase offsets.
cards.conveys: Signals continuous cyclic processing.
useWhen: Show that a file operation is still running.
Use a short repeating motion to communicate signals continuous cyclic processing.

cards.name: Chomp Loader
cards.what: A circular character opens its mouth as a row of dots moves into it.
cards.conveys: Makes waiting feel playful.
useWhen: Use a playful waiting cue in a game-related interface.
Use a short repeating motion to communicate makes waiting feel playful.

cards.name: Circular Dot Wave
cards.what: Dots around a circle brighten sequentially.
cards.conveys: Signals an active clockwise waiting cycle.
useWhen: Provide a compact waiting indicator beside a save action.
Use a short repeating motion to communicate signals an active clockwise waiting cycle.

cards.name: Color Cycle
cards.what: A surface cycles slowly through a small palette.
cards.conveys: Suggests variety and continuing activity.

Use a short repeating motion to communicate suggests variety and continuing activity.

cards.name: Energy Orb
cards.what: A luminous orb gently deforms while light circulates inside.
cards.conveys: Suggests focused energy and an idle listening state.
useWhen: Show an idle voice-input state.
Give a composition a single visual focal point.

cards.name: Firefly Twinkle
cards.what: Floating lights brighten and dim with independent rhythms.
cards.conveys: Creates a warm, living nighttime atmosphere.
useWhen: Build a warm night scene.
Populate a space with small luminous accents.

cards.name: Flickering Grid
cards.what: Selected grid cells fade in and out at staggered times.
cards.conveys: Suggests digital activity and independently active units.
useWhen: Add subtle activity to a digital background.
Represent independently active units abstractly.

cards.name: Flowing Wave Field
cards.what: Phase-shifted curves flow across the frame like waves.
cards.conveys: Creates an organic sense of flow and connection.
useWhen: Build a calm wave background for a technology introduction.

cards.name: Folding Cube Loader
cards.what: Four small panels fold and unfold in sequence.
cards.conveys: Suggests a repeating assembly cycle.
useWhen: Use folding tiles for an assembly-related waiting state.
Use a short repeating motion to communicate suggests a repeating assembly cycle.

cards.name: Gradient Drift
cards.what: Large gradient regions drift slowly across the surface.
cards.conveys: Creates a soft atmosphere and a sense of ongoing activity.
useWhen: Create a calm background behind a product introduction.
Use a short repeating motion to communicate creates a soft atmosphere and a sense of ongoing activity.

cards.name: Grid Pulse
cards.what: Grid cells shrink and grow with diagonal phase offsets.
cards.conveys: Suggests multiple work units being processed continuously.
useWhen: Represent ongoing batch processing with a compact grid.

cards.name: Hourglass Loader
cards.what: Sand drains between two triangular chambers before the hourglass flips.
cards.conveys: Communicates the passage of time while waiting.

cards.name: Hypnotic Pattern
cards.what: Repeated geometric bands rotate to create a rhythmic visual pattern.
cards.conveys: Creates abstract momentum and concentrated visual attention.

cards.name: Infinity Path Loader
cards.what: A short stroke travels continuously around an infinity path.
cards.conveys: Suggests uninterrupted ongoing progress.
useWhen: Show continuous synchronization with an infinity-shaped route.
Use a short repeating motion to communicate suggests uninterrupted ongoing progress.

cards.name: Marching Ants
cards.what: Dashes travel along an outline as their phase advances.
cards.conveys: Indicates direction or a selected boundary.
useWhen: Show the direction of a connection.
Keep a selection boundary visible.

cards.name: Mesh Gradient Flow
cards.what: Colors blend as soft centers drift and change size.
cards.conveys: Creates a calm, fluid background.
useWhen: Brand introductions need a restrained palette in motion.
Long waiting screens need gentle background movement.

cards.name: Nature Growth Loop
cards.what: Natural shapes grow in stages and return to their starting size.
cards.conveys: Creates a calm and organic waiting atmosphere.
useWhen: Use a small growing plant in an environmental service waiting state.
Use a short repeating motion to communicate creates a calm and organic waiting atmosphere.

cards.name: Offset Loop
cards.what: Each repetition adds its final displacement and continues forward.
cards.conveys: Communicates accumulation and ongoing travel.
useWhen: Explain cumulative displacement.
Represent repeated production or rising stages.

cards.name: Orbit Loop
cards.what: Objects orbit a central subject while keeping their labels upright.
cards.conveys: Shows relationships organized around a shared center.
useWhen: Explain integrations around a central service.
Use a short repeating motion to communicate shows relationships organized around a shared center.

cards.name: Path Conveyor
cards.what: Small objects travel repeatedly along a conveyor-like route.
cards.conveys: Shows staged processing and production flow.
useWhen: Explain a repeating production queue with objects on a shared route.
Use a short repeating motion to communicate shows staged processing and production flow.

cards.name: Radar Sweep
cards.what: A bright scan sweeps across an area and leaves brief highlights.
cards.conveys: Communicates scanning and detection.
useWhen: Show an active search.
Explain the order in which locations are detected.

cards.name: Rolling Shape Loop
cards.what: A shape translates along a floor while rotating in proportion to its travel.
cards.conveys: Suggests repeated work involving movement.
useWhen: Use a rolling shape to indicate repeated transport.
Use a short repeating motion to communicate suggests repeated work involving movement.

cards.name: Rotating Plane Loader
cards.what: A square flips around its horizontal and vertical axes in sequence.
cards.conveys: Provides a simple repeating geometric waiting cue.
useWhen: Use a minimal geometric indicator during calculation.

cards.name: Tiled Pattern Drift
cards.what: A tiled pattern drifts continuously and reconnects at its boundary.
cards.conveys: Adds directional flow to a geometric background.
useWhen: Animate a geometric background.
Suggest steady direction with low visual contrast.

cards.name: Wandering Squares
cards.what: Small squares travel around a closed rectangular route while rotating and scaling.
cards.conveys: Suggests several objects working through a repeating cycle.
useWhen: Add a compact multi-object waiting loop to a collaboration scene.

cards.name: Watching Eyes
cards.what: Pupils look from side to side and the eyelids briefly close.
cards.conveys: Adds a friendly sense of life to a waiting state.
useWhen: Give a chatbot waiting icon a gentle gaze and blink.
