cards.name: Wiggle Loop
cards.what: An irregular wobble reconnects smoothly at the loop boundary.
cards.conveys: Adds organic life to repeated motion.
useWhen: Bring hand-drawn elements to life.
Repeat a subtle background wobble.

cards.name: Circular Text Spin
cards.what: A sentence set around a circle rotates continuously about its center.
cards.conveys: Suggests cycling and continuity and gives badges or stickers a living expression.
useWhen: Spin a circular 'SCROLL DOWN' badge.
Rotate a repeated slogan like a seal.

cards.name: Credit Roll
cards.what: A list of names and roles scrolls upward at a constant speed.
cards.conveys: People are credited in order and hierarchy. It signals the end of the story.
useWhen: Crediting contributors, sources and thanks at the end of a video
Sending a name list scrolling at the end of a presentation

cards.name: Analog Medium Text
cards.what: Chalk letters are written, then an eraser band passes over leaving a faint smudge.
cards.conveys: The act of writing and erasing on a blackboard; analog warmth with a clear sequence.
useWhen: Teaching content that writes a key concept and wipes it before the next
Class-toned video openers

cards.name: Caption Page Swap
cards.what: One or two lines of caption swap wholesale in a fixed bottom slot, timed to each utterance.
cards.conveys: Dialogue reads steadily and the caption never jumps, so attention stays on the speaker and the picture.
useWhen: Basic captions on interviews, lectures and narration
Showing dialogue over busy footage without distraction

cards.name: Caption Takeover
cards.what: The usual caption line swaps for a huge full-frame title for one beat, then returns to the reading rail.
cards.conveys: The climax of a sentence lands once, big. The screen stays quiet, then speaks.
useWhen: When the single most important sentence should fill the frame
When a plain caption video needs a rhythmic peak

cards.name: Crosshair Caption
cards.what: Two thin lines converge on the center of a word, then the letters appear instantly.
cards.conveys: Sharp attention like verification or targeting; the word feels captured.
useWhen: Locking onto a key word in an investigative or analytical tone
Fixing the viewer's eye on a metric or name in a product demo

cards.name: Hologram Text Boot
cards.what: A projection cone ignites from a glowing point and a scanning light builds a text panel upward.
cards.conveys: Virtual information switching on in space: futuristic and technical.
useWhen: System-boot openings for AI or tech products
Floating dashboards or result panels like spatial UI

cards.name: Karaoke Caption
cards.what: The caption line stays put while only the color or pill background of the spoken word moves.
cards.conveys: Locks the reading position to the audio so viewers never lose their place.
useWhen: Make fast-speaking lecture or interview captions easy to follow.
Sync song or rap lyric captions to the beat.

cards.name: Laser Ignite Text
cards.what: Two beams converge on the word position and the letters ignite at the point of contact.
cards.conveys: A stage-like sense of information being made from light: the word is born as energy.
useWhen: The dramatic first reveal of a product name or slogan
Title openers on dark backgrounds

cards.name: LED Matrix Text
cards.what: Dot-matrix letters light up column by column from the left, flicker briefly on arrival, then hold.
cards.conveys: Information arriving on a display board: digital, mechanical, dependable.
useWhen: Retro signboard, transit display or digital clock style titles
A short status phrase arriving on screen

cards.name: Lower Third Reveal
cards.what: A speaker name and role slide in on a background bar at the lower part of the frame, hold, then leave.
cards.conveys: It quietly tells viewers who is speaking and in what context.
useWhen: Introducing a speaker for the first time in interviews or talks
Placing a name tag for a person or location at the bottom of the frame

cards.name: Lyric Line Focus
cards.what: Each new lyric line rises to center while the previous line is pushed up and dimmed.
cards.conveys: Draws the eye to the line being sung while keeping the previous line for context.
useWhen: Make lyric videos or music intros.
Bring sequential sentences into focus one at a time.

cards.name: Papercut Placement
cards.what: Paper word cutouts are dropped in at crooked angles and jitter at a low frame rate.
cards.conveys: The tactile warmth of craft and stop-motion, with a hand-made humor.
useWhen: Captions in craft, kids, cooking or DIY toned videos
Warm titles that shed the digital look

cards.name: Stamp Impact
cards.what: Text hovers large, drops onto the screen, presses in for a beat, and stops.
cards.conveys: Declaration and confirmation: the verdict has weight.
useWhen: Stamping a result word such as "Approved", "Confirmed" or "Rejected"
Nailing a scene's conclusion down in one word

cards.name: Subject Occluded Caption
cards.what: Large caption sits behind the speaker so the body partly covers the letters.
cards.conveys: The words appear to live in real space with the person in front, giving the footage depth.
useWhen: Blowing up a key word on a single centered speaker
Placing a highlight phrase into the scene behind the person

cards.name: Word Pop Caption
cards.what: Each spoken word pops in turn to form short caption groups.
cards.conveys: Signals stress and reading position even in fast speech, making the rhythm of talk visible in short-form video.
useWhen: Make TikTok or Reels style captions.
Emphasize key words in fast-paced speech.
